# Scribd Downloader

> Free high-speed online document and slide deck downloader to convert Scribd documents, academic research papers, and presentations to PDF with zero wait time.

## Documentation and Pages
- [Home](https://scrobd-downloader.vercel.app/): Main document converter and slide viewer interface
- [Blog](https://scrobd-downloader.vercel.app/blog): Educational guides, tutorials, and research document extraction tips

## Key Features
- High-resolution PDF generation with high speed
- Interactive horizontal and thumbnail slide viewer
- Zero login or account requirement
- Complete mobile and desktop support
